mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in FEDFUNDS above 2.5% over two consecutive quarters signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, which raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.5% for two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in UNRATE below 3.5% coincident with a concurrent drop in PAYEMS signals weakening labor demand, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.10) during triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly decline in GDPC1 signals weakening aggregate demand, which depresses corporate profits and equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 declines but S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of such quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly contraction in INDPRO below 97.0 (relative to previous month) signals supply chain stress, which raises input costs and reduces profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during INDPRO contraction months.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in HOUST and RSAFS signals increased housing and savings activity, which in a low-interest environment may reflect precautionary behavior and reduced risk appetite, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > previous month AND RSAFS > previous month
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both HOUST and RSAFS rise month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in CPIAUCSL above 6% month-over-month signals high inflation, which erodes real corporate earnings and prompts central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL spikes above 6%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both UNRATE and PAYEMS above their 12-month moving averages signals robust labor market expansion, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive during episodes of simultaneous above-average UNRATE and PAYEMS growth.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in GDPC1 above its 12-month moving average signals strengthening aggregate demand, which supports corporate earnings and equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when GDPC1 exceeds its 12-month moving average.
